page.overview:
What is Long Life Mountain?

Long Life Mountain is part of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kunlun_Mountains Kunlun Mountain Range], and its tip reaches the sky. It is surrounded by auspicious red mists and pink clouds. Below the cliffs grow delicate grass, and above the cliffs grow fragrant plum trees. The Five Villages Abbey is located at its top
